# CPIN.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v2) with a 12-month target of Rp3,650.0 against Rp2,370.0 (expected total return 63.3%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: washout_rebound · method card: per fund record routing for Poultry, feed & protein.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The policy driver is over-read by an order of magnitude. S8 says Bapanas will distribute 242 thousand tonnes of feed corn in 2026 on a Rp678bn budget, up 372.6% on the 51.2kt actually delivered in 2025 to 3,578 layer far
- A key input the analyst knows is wrong was modelled around, not restated. D&A is Rp310bn against PPE of Rp18,060bn (1.7%) and capex of Rp1,771bn, and §3 says outright "the D&A line is the pack's and is likely understated
- The three methods do not share a horizon. P/E 5,035 is 14.63x FY2025A EPS of Rp344 and EV/EBITDA 5,058 is 10.36x FY2025A EBITDA of Rp8,443, while the DCF discounts FY2026E onward. Applied to FY2026E - the year the whole 

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
